title: Security Engineer AI
description:
My client, a leading international organisation, is looking to
recruit an experienced Security Engineer to join their Cyber
Security and Compliance team, with a focus on developing their AI
defence capabilities.

This is an exciting opportunity to take ownership of AI security
initiatives, protecting the organisation's AI systems whilst
using emerging technologies to enhance cyber security
capabilities.

Main duties will include:

· Evaluating, selecting and implementing AI security tools
and technologies.

· Identifying and mitigating AI-specific threats, including
prompt injection, data leakage and model poisoning.

· Integrating AI security solutions with existing security
platforms and infrastructure.

· Developing AI-driven solutions to improve threat
detection, vulnerability management and incident response.

· Conducting security assessments, threat modelling and
adversarial testing of AI systems.

· Working closely with stakeholders to develop and implement
effective AI security controls.

The successful candidate will have:

· Proven experience in cyber security engineering, cloud
security, security architecture or SOC engineering.

· Strong knowledge of AI, machine learning, large language
models (LLMs) and associated security risks.

· Experience implementing and integrating enterprise
security tools.

· Familiarity with frameworks such as OWASP Top 10 for LLM
Applications, MITRE ATLAS and NIST AI RMF.

· Experience with cloud platforms and Python or other
scripting languages.

· Excellent communication skills and a proactive, hands-on
approach.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established
organisation and play a key role in shaping its approach to AI
security.

If this role looks of interest, please apply now or contact the
team at Eclectic!

?

We endeavour to reply to every candidate, every time, but if you
haven't heard back within 10 days, please understand that you
have unfortunately been unsuccessful for this position, or the
position has been filled. Please call the office or send an email
to discuss other potential opportunities.
